description: This PHP source file generates a webpage displaying information about connected USB devices on a gateway device, including device status, description, serial number, speed, and manufacturer for each connected USB port.

methods.name: getInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of instance IDs for USB devices based on the specified OID pattern.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the device data based on the specified OID.
